integrity: Complete statement, analytic proof, and exact standard-library reproducibility checker are included; no independent validation or universal automated proof is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp threshold concerns monotonicity of the probability odds of exactly three versus exactly two leaves, not all likelihood ratios at small sizes. Exact coefficient arithmetic certifies only n=4,...,12, while all-size assertions have separate analytic proofs. The historic priority search cannot prove uniqueness.
title: A thirteen-vertex reversal in rare-leaf odds for leaf-driven preferential attachment
